name: How long does a home remodeling project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a home remodeling project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home remodeling project varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A small bathroom remodel might take a few weeks, while a full kitchen renovation could extend to several months. Whole-home remodels can take six months to a year or more. Factors like material lead times, permitting delays, and unforeseen issues can also impact the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design phase is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope, from a few weeks for small jobs to several months or more for larger remodels.
